event_dispatch_attempts_lease_check.name: event_dispatch_attempts_lease_check
event_dispatch_attempts_lease_check.value: ("event_dispatch_attempts"."status" = 'PROCESSING' and "event_dispatch_attempts"."locked_at" is not null and "event_dispatch_attempts"."locked_by" is not null) or ("event_dispatch_attempts"."status" <> 'PROCESSING' and "event_dispatch_attempts"."locked_at" is null and "event_dispatch_attempts"."locked_by" is null)

m08_cycle_completion_target.name: m08_cycle_completion_target
m08_cycle_completion_target.value: "cycles"."completion_next_cycle_id" IS NULL OR ("cycles"."completion_next_cycle_id" <> "cycles"."id" AND "cycles"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

issue_statuses_default_usable_check.name: issue_statuses_default_usable_check
issue_statuses_default_usable_check.value: NOT "issue_statuses"."is_default" OR ("issue_statuses"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "issue_statuses"."category" IN ('BACKLOG','UNSTARTED'))

issues_milestone_requires_project.name: issues_milestone_requires_project
issues_milestone_requires_project.value: "issues"."milestone_id" IS NULL OR "issues"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

projects_target_date_check.name: projects_target_date_check
projects_target_date_check.value: "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."target_date" is null or "projects"."target_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

teams_cycle_settings_check.name: teams_cycle_settings_check
teams_cycle_settings_check.value: "teams"."cycle_duration_weeks" BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND "teams"."cycle_start_day" BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND "teams"."cycle_cooldown_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 14 AND "teams"."cycle_cooldown_days" < "teams"."cycle_duration_weeks" * 7 AND "teams"."upcoming_cycles_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 10

labels_team_name_active_idx.name: labels_team_name_active_idx
labels_team_name_active_idx.where: "labels"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "labels"."archived_at" IS NULL

attachments_issue_active_idx.name: attachments_issue_active_idx
attachments_issue_active_idx.where: "attachments"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "attachments"."issue_id" IS NOT NULL

attachments_project_active_idx.name: attachments_project_active_idx
attachments_project_active_idx.where: "attachments"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "attachments"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

attachments_comment_active_idx.name: attachments_comment_active_idx
attachments_comment_active_idx.where: "attachments"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "attachments"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL

m10_file_name.name: m10_file_name
m10_file_name.value: trim("files"."name") <> '' AND length("files"."name") <= 255 AND "files"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]/]' AND position(chr(92) in "files"."name") = 0

m10_file_ready_metadata.name: m10_file_ready_metadata
m10_file_ready_metadata.value: "files"."status" <> 'READY' OR ("files"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "files"."actual_size_bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."actual_size_bytes" = "files"."size_bytes" AND "files"."actual_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."actual_sha256" = "files"."sha256" AND "files"."actual_mime_type" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."actual_mime_type" = "files"."declared_mime_type")

m10_file_lifecycle_timestamps.name: m10_file_lifecycle_timestamps
m10_file_lifecycle_timestamps.value: ("files"."status" <> 'UPLOADED' OR "files"."uploaded_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("files"."status" <> 'QUARANTINED' OR "files"."quarantined_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("files"."status" <> 'DELETED' OR "files"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("files"."status" <> 'PURGED' OR "files"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL)

m10_cleanup_lease.name: m10_cleanup_lease
m10_cleanup_lease.value: "storage_cleanup_jobs"."status" <> 'PROCESSING' OR ("storage_cleanup_jobs"."locked_until" IS NOT NULL AND "storage_cleanup_jobs"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL)
